_doc: Latest filing dates + payor concentration per obligor for predictive detector library

_methodology.late_filing_detector: Anything > 270 days post-FYE without filed audited FS is the signal. Calendar-year FYE obligors (12/31/2024) should have filed by Sept-Oct 2025; June-FYE obligors (6/30/2025) should have filed by March-April 2026.
_methodology.payor_pct_method: Payor mix as % of net patient revenue (or gross revenue where specified). Some obligors disclose only narrative percentages; others provide $ breakdowns. Self-pay/other category is residual.
_methodology.confidence_calibration: HIGH = direct disclosure with exact percentages from audited FS or MDA narrative. MEDIUM = narrative disclosure of governmental share (Medicare+Medicaid combined) without commercial split, or 3rd-party press citation of exact figures. LOW = inferred from older data, similar facility, or unable to locate; warning flag set.
_methodology.sources_used: Local MDAs in data/mdas/ (6 of 35); WebSearch for EMMA/IR pages/state regulator filings; trade press (Becker's, Bond Buyer, local papers); HCAI/HSCRC/CT-OHS/MHDO state hospital data offices.
